'''Redwing''' is a horse owned by [[Medore Damara]].

==Activities==
Because ''[[Cha Faile]]'' want to emulate the [[Aiel]], [[Perrin Aybara]] tells them that they must walk. Medore Damara becomes obstinant because she can't ride Redwing, her favorite horse.
